thread:
sanjay: We need someone to run the after-action review for the network flapping incident (impact: multiple customers, degraded performance). Tentative window next Tue or Wed 10:00-12:00 PT. Who can take the organizer role?

maya: I'd like to, but I'm OOO Tue morning. Can do Wed 10:00 PT.

alex: I can step in as primary if Maya wants to co-host. I can do Tue or Wed.

jordan: +1 to Alex if Maya prefers to co-host. Need someone to own the customer-impact section (Emily?).

emily: I can do the customer-impact writeup. Wed is better for me (need data from billing team first).

incident-bot: Incident #4721 summary: network flapping caused 2.3x error spike between 03:12–03:50 UTC. Affected services: inference-gateway, realtime-cache. Pager duty runbook executed. Link: https://incidents.example/4721

ops-lead: Reminder: organizer should publish pre-read 24h before the slot and assign action scribe. Also add runbook failures to remediation list.

sanjay: Good call. Two asks: (1) pick organizer, (2) confirm scribe + pre-read owner.

alex: I'll be organizer. @maya will co-host. @emily will do customer-impact section. Who can scribe?

tae: I can scribe for the session. Will take notes + actions.

maya: Great — I'll pull metrics for the 03:12 window and draft timeline. Alex can lead the technical RCA, Emily on customer impact, Tae on actions.

jordan: Can someone create a calendar invite and add the Ops, SRE, Networking, and Product contacts? We should include external-facing comms folks.

alex: I'll create the invite. Proposed agenda in invite: 1) timeline & metrics (Maya) 2) RCA (Alex) 3) customer impact (Emily) 4) action items & owners (Tae) 5) follow-ups & SLAs (Ops-lead).

emily: Also add a brief QA/rollback history section — we tried two mitigations that weekend.

alex: Will do. Draft invite text: "After-action for Incident #4721 — review timeline, RCA, customer impact, and remediation plan. Pre-read: logs + alerts + mitigation timeline (see incident page). Please RSVP."

ops-lead: Tagging compliance for any data-access notes. If there's PII in logs, redact in pre-read.

incident-bot: Action created: create-calendar-invite by alex assigned. Due: 1766077634 (24h before Wed slot).

alex: Calendar done. Invite sent for Wed 10:00–11:00 PT. Pre-read owner: @maya (due Tue EOD). Scribe: @tae. Link: https://calendar.example/event/aa-4721

maya: I'll post the pre-read here once billing confirms the customer list. Expect it by Tue 18:00 PT.

tae: I'll prep a Notion doc for actions and will update during the meeting: https://notion.example/AA-4721

sanjay: Thanks all. One last ask — if anyone can't make the slot, please propose alternates by EOD today so we can avoid a no-show.

alex: If Maya has a blocker Wed morning, I can move it to Tue 11:00 PT. Hold for confirmations. :thumbsup:

maya: Confirmed — Wed stands for me.

emily: Confirmed.

tae: Confirmed.

jordan: Will invite Product PM (Lina) and Comms (Hector).

ops-lead: I'll be there to review SLA impact notes.

sanjay: Great — session owner: alex, co-host: maya, pre-read owner: maya, scribe: tae, customer-impact: emily. See invite.

alex: After the meeting I'll open follow-up tickets for remediation and link them to the incident page. We'll aim to close critical action items within 2 weeks.

incident-bot: Follow-up task created: remediation-ticket-4721 assigned to alex. Due: 1767213634.

sanjay: Thanks team — closing thread.
